title: The deficit that matters most isn't the headline one
sources: Union Budget 2026-27, Budget at a Glance: Budget Estimates 2026-27 fiscal deficit 4.3% of GDP, revenue deficit 1.5%, primary deficit 0.7% (indiabudget.gov.in)
Budget Speech 2026-27: debt-to-GDP target of 50 +/- 1 percent by 2030-31; 55.6% estimated for 2026-27 (indiabudget.gov.in)
PRS Legislative Research, Union Budget Analysis 2026-27

quiz.why: Right. Primary deficit is the fiscal deficit minus interest payments, so it shows the gap from current spending without the cost of past debt.

script: The fiscal deficit gets the headlines:
4.3 percent of GDP
four point three percent of G D P
in the 2026-27 budget.
in the twenty twenty-six twenty-seven budget.
But much of that gap pays for the past.
The primary deficit is the fiscal deficit minus interest payments.
It shows the gap from today's spending alone.
The same budget puts it at just 0.7 percent of GDP.
The same budget puts it at just zero point seven percent of G D P.
So about 3.6 points of the deficit is interest.
So about three point six points of the deficit is interest.
The medium-term anchor is debt:
about 50 percent of GDP,
about fifty percent of G D P,
give or take one point,
by March 2031.
by March twenty thirty-one.
Shrink the primary deficit,
and new borrowing mostly services old debt.
Your turn.
What is the primary deficit?

claims.claim: Budget Estimates 2026-27: fiscal deficit 4.3% of GDP; primary deficit 0.7% of GDP; revenue deficit 1.5%
Primary deficit = fiscal deficit minus interest payments; hence about 3.6 percentage points of GDP (4.3 minus 0.7) is interest
The government aims to bring Central debt to around 50% of GDP (+/- 1) by March 2031 (2030-31)
Central debt is estimated at 55.6% of GDP in 2026-27 BE

review_note: Spec written after the fact for the existing video and Sarvam recording; spoken text matches 19-primary-deficit.voice.txt word for word. Claims copied from the claims table. Now checked against primary sources: Budget at a Glance 2026-27 (indiabudget.gov.in) shows BE 2026-27 fiscal deficit 4.3, revenue deficit 1.5 and primary deficit 0.7 percent of GDP, with primary deficit computed as fiscal deficit less interest; the Budget Speech states the 50 +/- 1 percent debt-to-GDP target by 2030-31 and 55.6 percent for 2026-27. 3.6 points is our arithmetic (4.3 - 0.7). Claim 4 (55.6%) is not spoken or shown; kept from the claims table as context. gsPaper adds prelims-gs to the old mains-gs3 tag.
